items.item_text: Required or equivalent certification High School Diploma
4-6 years Advanced knowledge in custodial and housekeeping services Required
Bloodborne pathogens and sharps disposal training.

Covered Individuals: A Covered Individual includes anyone designated as Personnel or Students under this Policy who physically access a University Facility or Program in connection with their employment, appointment, or education/training. A person accessing a Healthcare Location as a patient, or an art, athletics, entertainment, or other publicly accessible venue at a Location as a member of the public, is not a Covered Individual.
Ability to evaluate employee performance and participate in the progressive discipline of staff
Ability to assign work orders to appropriate crew leaders and delegate responsibilities according to operational needs
Ability to respond to complaints and requests form clients
Ability to meet with clients regularly to review service delivery and clients' concerns
Ability to keep clients informed with respect to changes in staffing and service delivery
Ability to report job related injuries and illnesses according to established procedures
Ability to develop and monitor modified assignments for injured or ill employees
Ability to ensure that employees submit proper medical documentation when ill or injured
Ability to counsel employees concerning performance and other problems, and to document problems and counseling sessions
Communication skills to keep supervisor informed of problems, recommend disciplinary action, and help manage discipline cases
Ability to maintain scheduling within prescribed budgetary guidelines and submit payroll information for all employees
Ability to report time worked on jobs on-line and approve and schedule vacation leave for subordinates
Ability to collect data, fill-in for subordinates in their absence, and perform other duties as needed
Ability to plan, organize, and direct routine custodial operations and ensure that work is done on time and to standards
Ability to work with crew leaders to resolve service-delivery problems

Ability to participate in Quality Assurance Program by performing inspections according to set schedule, train and supervise the custodial staff to maintain an orderly, safe, and efficient cleaning operation, ensure that employees are trained with respect to custodial methods such that only authorized equipment and products are used and used properly, and ensure that employees observe safe work practices
Ability to ensure that safety training is conducted monthly and submit training reports to supervisor and Facilities Services safety officer
Requires knowledge in the care and use of power equipment and has the ability to test new equipment and products
Ability to enforce safety, hazardous materials, and custodial policies and procedures are adhered to, maintain file of Material Safety Data Sheets, and report safety hazards and vandalism
Ability to request services from other Facilities Services units via the web server
Ability to enforce biohazardous materials, equipment, and clean room policies and procedures and enforce proper handling and mixture of chemicals
